messages:
elaine: Uploaded a new variant of the model catalog compare table — two options: compact inline badges (minimal width) vs dedicated badge column. Link: figma.com/file/variant_compact

sam: Inline badges look friendlier but get noisy when there are three badges. Column seems cleaner for scanning. Also worried about keyboard focus hits with inline badges.

kevin: From an implementation POV column = simpler for focusable controls. Inline requires careful hit target sizing. If we do column, we should allow column collapsing on small screens.

mika: UX thought: if we use a badge column, add labels in the header (icon + "Performance") and allow toggling visibility (so power users can collapse cost or reliability).

tess: Accessibility: ensure badge icons are not the only affordance — include off-screen text for screen readers like "Performance: p95 48ms". Also color contrast on the small pill backgrounds needs review.

kevin: CSS idea: badge column collapses to icons < 600px and expands into a stacked summary panel on row expand. That avoids horizontal scroll while retaining info.

elaine: Microcopy: change column header from "Perf" to an icon with aria-label="Performance"; keep visible label in tooltip. Also show a small help icon linking to metric defs (p50/p95).

sam: About pinning: if we show a pin in the row, should pinned rows float to top? I prefer they don't — sorting expectations get weird. We can add a filter at the top "Show pinned".

mika: Agreed — visual mark + filter. Also add a small animation when pin toggled for discoverability.

tess: I'll produce a checklist: contrast tokens, aria-label examples, tooltip usage, keyboard flow. Will post in the thread tomorrow.

kevin: I'll sketch a minimal prototype with a collapsible badge column and keyboard targets. ETA Thu.

elaine: Action items: kevin prototype (Thu), tess a11y checklist (Wed), mika update copy + pinned filter mock (Wed). design-bot: Reminder: sync Friday 2pm in #design-review.

mika: Thanks — new figma link when ready and I'll schedule quick review.
